notes: Golden-audio corpus for the Supertonic 3 TTS release gate (NEU-71, plan workstream E). One fixed sentence per supported language; every sentence is a single tokenizer chunk (<= 120 chars, under the 120-char ko/ja segment cap of the reference chunker). Text must stay byte-stable: editing a sentence invalidates the blessed manifest in tools/tts-golden/manifest.json.
